name: DeMarker gaining position volume
summary: This EA uses the DeMarker oscillator to identify momentum shifts and enters positions when the indicator signals gaining momentum, with volume-based position sizing. It opens trades in the direction of the detected momentum when DeMarker crosses key threshold levels, typically buying on dips from overbought zones and selling on rallies from oversold zones.
summary_zh: 该EA使用DeMarker振荡器识别动量变化，当指标发出动量增强信号时入场，并根据成交量调整仓位大小。它在DeMarker穿越关键阈值水平时沿动量方向开仓，通常在超买区回落时买入，超卖区反弹时卖出。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于DeMarker振荡器的动量判断，DeMarker值低于0.3视为超卖区域，高于0.7视为超买区域。入场条件为DeMarker从超卖区向上穿越时做多，从超买区向下穿越时做空，表明动量正在积聚。仓位管理采用基于成交量的动态仓位调整，根据市场成交量变化来决定开仓规模。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及DeMarker反向穿越信号。资金管理方面，EA支持手数配置和风险百分比设置，但缺乏高级的资金管理机制如凯利公式或动态风险调整。整体策略逻辑清晰，但DeMarker作为单一指标存在滞后性和虚假信号的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the DeMarker oscillator for momentum identification, with DeMarker values below 0.3 considered oversold and above 0.7 considered overbought. Entry conditions trigger a buy when DeMarker crosses upward from oversold territory and a sell when it crosses downward from overbought territory, signaling momentum accumulation. Position sizing employs volume-based dynamic adjustment, scaling trade size according to market volume changes. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as DeMarker reverse crossover signals. Money management supports configurable lot sizes and risk percentage settings, but lacks advanced mechanisms such as Kelly criterion or dynamic risk adjustment. The overall strategy logic is clear, but relying on DeMarker as a single indicator introduces lag and false signal vulnerability.

pros: 使用DeMarker振荡器逻辑清晰，策略可解释性强
基于成交量的动态仓位管理能适应市场活跃度变化
具有明确的超买超卖阈值，入场条件客观明确
pros_en: DeMarker oscillator provides clear and interpretable momentum signals
Volume-based dynamic position sizing adapts to market activity levels
Well-defined overbought/oversold thresholds create objective entry conditions
cons: 单一指标策略容易产生虚假信号，缺乏多重确认机制
DeMarker作为滞后指标在快速反转市场中反应迟缓
缺少点差过滤和新闻事件过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
cons_en: Single-indicator strategy is prone to false signals without multi-confirmation
DeMarker as a lagging indicator responds slowly in fast-reversal markets
Lacks spread filter and news event filter, may open positions under adverse conditions
improvements: 增加多重确认机制，如结合趋势指标EMA或MACD过滤信号
添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add multi-confirmation mechanism by combining trend indicators like EMA or MACD for signal filtering
Implement spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid high-spread and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 单一指标缺乏多重确认，虚假信号可能导致连续亏损
未明确是否包含新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
成交量仓位调整在极端行情下可能放大风险敞口
risk_points_en: Single indicator without multi-confirmation may cause consecutive losses from false signals
No explicit new bar check may lead to repeated position opening on the same bar
Volume-based position adjustment may amplify risk exposure during extreme market conditions
